cards.title: Direct Calculation of MM Parameters from MRT-Dose Relationship
cards.claim: The study provides direct methods for calculating Michaelis-Menten parameters (Vmax, Km) based on the relationship between Mean Residence Time (MRT) and dose.
conditions: Availability of MRT values across different doses.
required_inputs: MRT values calculated at multiple dose levels.
limitations: The specific algebraic equations for this direct calculation are not present in the abstract.
Requires accurate MRT calculation, which itself depends on the correct definition (see Card 1).
cards.downstream_use: Potential method for estimating nonlinear parameters without full compartmental fitting if MRT can be reliably estimated from concentration-time data. Requires full-text access to implement the specific equations.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
